europe_now.title: Paris Unrest Measures
europe_now.summary: Authorities in Paris have banned protests following recent violent demonstrations and civil unrest. The civil disruptions have also caused French bond yields to climb to a 24-year high.

europe_now.title: European Parliament Raids
europe_now.summary: European Union prosecutors have conducted searches at the European Parliament offices of a far-right political group in Brussels and Strasbourg. The investigation centers on allegations regarding the misuse of parliamentary funds.

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest and Security Measures in France

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Developments in the Ukraine Conflict
top_stories.summary: Russia announced its readiness to resume three-way peace talks involving Ukraine and the United States. Meanwhile, missile strikes hit Kyiv as international leaders debated diplomatic strategies for ending the war.

top_stories.title: European Parliament Financial Investigation
top_stories.summary: EU prosecutors executed raids on the European Parliament offices of the far-right Patriots for Europe group. The searches were conducted in Brussels and Strasbourg as part of an inquiry into suspected misuse of parliamentary funds.
